_meta.note: All token types sent in token-based packet data streams (tabular result, packet type 0x04)

tokens.name: ALTMETADATA
tokens.description: Describes the data type, length, and name of column data that result from a SQL statement that generates totals (COMPUTE clause). Must be preceded by COLMETADATA.

structure.desc: Number of aggregate operators (ComputeData elements)
Unique ID for this ALTMETADATA in the result set; matches Id in ALTROW
Number of grouping columns
Column numbers from the GROUP BY clause

fields.desc: Aggregate operator (AOPSTDEV=0x30, AOPSTDEVP=0x31, AOPVAR=0x32, AOPVARP=0x33, AOPCNT=0x34, AOPSUM=0x4D, AOPAVG=0x4F, AOPMIN=0x51, AOPMAX=0x52)
1-based column number in result set that is the operand
Same flag bits as COLMETADATA (fNullable, fCaseSen, etc.)
Only if text/ntext/image column; SHOULD never be sent

notes: ALTROW tokens must be in the same result set as their ALTMETADATA
UserType valid values: 0x0000 or 0x00000000, except timestamp (0x0050/0x00000050) and alias types (>0x00FF or >0x000000FF)

tokens.name: ALTROW
tokens.description: Sends a complete row of total data. Format defined by corresponding ALTMETADATA token.

structure.desc: Matches Id in ALTMETADATA_TOKEN
Column data

tokens.name: COLINFO
tokens.description: Describes column information in browse mode (sp_cursoropen, sp_cursorfetch). The TABNAME token contains the actual table name.

structure.desc: Length of ColProperty stream in bytes (excludes token type and length fields)

fields.desc: Base table number; 0 if Status is EXPRESSION
Base column name; only present if DIFFERENT_NAME bit is set in Status

tokens.name: COLMETADATA
tokens.description: Describes the result set for interpretation of following ROW data streams. Sent before any ROW tokens.

structure.desc: Number of columns. 0xFFFF means no metadata (NoMetaData flag); same effect as 0.

fields.desc: Always 16-bit regardless of TDS version. Bits (LSB order): fNullable(1=nullable), fCaseSen(1=binary collation or XML), usUpdateable(2-bit: 0=readonly,1=r/w,2=unknown), fIdentity, fComputed(TDS7.2), usReservedODBC(2-bit, TDS7.3A and below only), fSparseColumnSet(TDS7.3.B, special XML col for sparse set), fEncrypted(TDS7.4), usReserved3(4-bit,TDS7.4), fHidden(TDS7.2), fKey(TDS7.2), fNullableUnknown(TDS7.2)
Present only for text, ntext, image columns. TDS 7.2+: NumParts(BYTE) + 1*PartName(US_VARCHAR). Pre-TDS7.2: US_VARCHAR.

notes: All COLMETADATA streams are grouped together
NoMetaData (0xFF 0xFF) notifies client no metadata follows; client uses metadata from a previous RPC Request
CekTable MUST be sent when COLUMNENCRYPTION is negotiated and turned on
Swift note: sqlserver-nio reads userType as ULONG (4 bytes) in static parser, but USHORT (2 bytes) in streaming parser — inconsistency vs spec

tokens.name: DATACLASSIFICATION
tokens.description: Describes the data classification (sensitivity labels) of the query result set. Only sent if client negotiated DATACLASSIFICATION FeatureExt.

structure.desc: Query-level rank: -1=NotDefined, 0=None, 10=Low, 20=Medium, 30=High, 40=Critical

notes: SensitivityRank sent only when both client and server negotiate DATACLASSIFICATION_VERSION=2
NumResultSetColumns=0 means additional info not sent

tokens.name: DONE
tokens.description: Indicates the completion status of a SQL statement. One DONE per SQL statement in a batch (except variable declarations). In stored procedures, DONEPROC/DONEINPROC are used instead.

structure.desc: Bitwise OR: 0x00=DONE_FINAL, 0x01=DONE_MORE (more streams follow), 0x02=DONE_ERROR (preceding ERROR token), 0x04=DONE_INXACT (transaction in progress), 0x10=DONE_COUNT (DoneRowCount is valid), 0x20=DONE_ATTN (acknowledgement of ATTENTION), 0x100=DONE_SRVERROR (severe error, discard result set)
Token of current SQL statement (controlled by application layer, not evaluated by TDS)
Affected row count; valid only when DONE_COUNT bit set in Status

notes: Multiple DONE tokens in a batch: all except the final have DONE_MORE set
If error in result set: ERROR token appears before DONE, and DONE has DONE_ERROR set

tokens.name: DONEINPROC
tokens.description: Indicates completion of a SQL statement within a stored procedure. Must be followed by another DONEPROC or DONEINPROC.

structure.desc: Same as DONE flags plus: 0x80=DONE_RPCINBATCH (not set on last RPC in batch)

tokens.name: DONEPROC
tokens.description: Indicates completion of a stored procedure. One DONEPROC per stored procedure called.

structure.desc: Same as DONE flags plus: 0x80=DONE_RPCINBATCH (not set on last RPC in RPC batch)

tokens.name: ENVCHANGE
tokens.description: Notification of an environment change (database, language, packet size, transaction, routing, etc.).

structure.desc: Total length of EnvValueData

type_table.name: Character Set
type_table.note: Only sent to TDS 7.0 or earlier

type_table.name: Packet Size
type_table.note: Server MAY send different value from client request; both must use negotiated value. Valid range: 512-32767

type_table.name: Unicode sorting local id
type_table.note: Only sent to TDS 7.0 or earlier

type_table.name: Unicode sorting comparison flags
type_table.note: Only sent to TDS 7.0 or earlier

type_table.name: Begin Transaction
type_table.note: TDS 7.2+; payload is ULONGLONG. Only for user-controlled transactions (SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON)

type_table.name: Promote Transaction
type_table.note: TDS 7.2+; sent in response to TM_PROMOTE_XACT

type_table.name: Routing
type_table.note: TDS 7.4+; Protocol MUST be 0 (TCP-IP); sent after LOGINACK

type_table.name: Enhanced Routing
type_table.note: TDS 7.4+; only if client sends ENHANCEDROUTINGSUPPORT FeatureExt; AlternateDatabase max 128 chars

notes: Types 1-6, 13, 19: payload is Unicode string; LENGTH = byte count
Types 8, 11, 17 NewValue and types 9, 10, 12 OldValue payload is ULONGLONG
For auto-commit transactions: no ENVCHANGE stream generated
For @@trancount changes only: no ENVCHANGE generated

tokens.name: ERROR
tokens.description: Sends an error message to the client. If error in result set, ERROR precedes DONE and DONE has DONE_ERROR bit set.

structure.desc: Total length of the ERROR data stream in bytes
Error number
Error state; modifier to error number
Severity: <10=informational, 10=informational, 11-16=user-correctable, 17-19=needs sysadmin, 20-25=fatal
Error message text
Stored procedure name or empty
Line number in SQL batch/stored procedure (0 if not applicable)

severity_levels.12: Special severity for no-lock reads (possible inconsistency)

tokens.name: FEATUREEXTACK
tokens.description: Acknowledges FeatureExt features requested in LOGIN7. Sent only along with LOGINACK in the login response.

fields.desc: Must match FeatureId from LOGIN7 FeatureExt request

feature_ack_data.name: FEDAUTH
feature_ack_data.ack_format: Live ID Compact Token: Nonce(32BYTE) + Signature(HMAC-SHA-256 of nonce, 32BYTE). Security Token: [Nonce(32BYTE)] if client PRELOGIN included NONCE.

feature_ack_data.name: AZURESQLSUPPORT
feature_ack_data.ack_format: BYTE (bit0: failover partner with read-only intent supported)

feature_ack_data.name: AZURESQLDNSCACHING
feature_ack_data.ack_format: IsSupported(BYTE: 0=not supported, 1=supported; if 0, client SHOULD NOT cache)

feature_ack_data.name: ENHANCEDROUTINGSUPPORT
feature_ack_data.ack_format: IsEnabled(BYTE: 0=not supported, 1=supported; if 0, client MUST NOT accept Enhanced Routing ENVCHANGE tokens)

tokens.name: FEDAUTHINFO
tokens.description: Returns federated authentication information to client during login process. MUST be the only token in a Federated Authentication Information message.

structure.desc: Length of whole token excluding TokenLength field itself; minimum = sizeof(DWORD) for CountOfInfoIDs
Number of FedAuthInfoOpt entries; 0 if none
Actual info data at offsets specified above

info_ids.name: STSURL
info_ids.format: Unicode string: token endpoint URL for acquiring Federated Authentication Token

info_ids.name: SPN
info_ids.format: Unicode string: Service Principal Name for acquiring Federated Authentication Token

tokens.name: INFO
tokens.description: Sends an informational message to the client. Same structure as ERROR token.

structure.desc: Info message number
Severity; <10=informational

tokens.name: LOGINACK
tokens.description: Response to LOGIN7. If not received, login is unsuccessful.

structure.desc: Length of Interface + TDSVersion + ProgName + ProgVersion
0=SQL_DFLT (server accepts whatever client sends), 1=SQL_TSQL (TSQL accepted)
TDS version the server is using
Server program name

tokens.name: NBCROW
tokens.description: Null Bitmap Compressed ROW. Sends a row as defined by COLMETADATA with null bitmap compression. Removes null column values from the row. MUST NOT be used in BulkLoadBCP or TVP streams.

structure.desc: One bit per column from COLMETADATA. Bit=1 means column is NULL and NOT present in row data. Bit=0 means column is present.
Only non-null columns are present, one ColumnData per non-null column

null_bitmap_layout.description: Columns ordered 0-based left to right. Byte 1 holds cols 0-7 with bit 0 (LSB) = col 0, bit 7 (MSB) = col 7. Byte 2 holds cols 8-15, etc.

notes: Server may intermix NBCROW and ROW tokens in same result set
Server chooses NBCROW for savings when nullable columns exist, ROW when no savings

tokens.name: OFFSET
tokens.description: Informs client where in the SQL text buffer a keyword occurs. Removed in TDS 7.2.

structure.desc: Offset in client SQL text buffer (MOD 64KB if >64KB)

tokens.name: ORDER
tokens.description: Informs client which columns the data is ordered by. Sent only when ORDER BY clause is executed.

structure.desc: Total length of ORDER data stream
Column numbers in the ORDER BY clause; repeated for each column

tokens.name: RETURNSTATUS
tokens.description: Sends return status of an RPC or T-SQL EXEC query. MUST be returned when RPC is executed by server. Value MUST NOT be NULL.

tokens.name: RETURNVALUE
tokens.description: Sends return value of an RPC to client. One RETURNVALUE per output/return parameter. UDF execution produces exactly one RETURNVALUE. Large Object output params reordered to end of stream (small params first, then large).

structure.desc: Ordinal position in original RPC call; Large Object params reordered to end
0x01=OUTPUT parameter of stored procedure, 0x02=return value of UDF
Should all be zero; same flag bits as COLMETADATA
Same structure as in COLMETADATA

tokens.name: ROW
tokens.description: Sends a complete row as defined by COLMETADATA. All columns are present (use NBCROW for null compression).

structure.desc: One ColumnData per column defined in COLMETADATA

column_data_detail.TextPointer: B_VARBYTE; only for text/ntext/image; MUST NOT be present if NULL (GEN_NULL)
column_data_detail.Timestamp: 8BYTE; only for text/ntext/image; MUST NOT be present if NULL

tokens.name: SESSIONSTATE
tokens.description: Sends session state data to client. Used for session recovery. MUST NOT be sent if SESSIONRECOVERY not negotiated. When sent, next token MUST be DONE or DONEPROC with DONE_FINAL.

structure.desc: Length of token stream excluding TokenType and Length
Sequence number starting at 0, incrementing. If reaches 0xFFFFFFFF, SESSIONRECOVERY permanently disabled; server should send fRecoverable=FALSE.
Bit 0 = fRecoverable: TRUE means all StateIds are recoverable; client MUST track this

fields.desc: If 0, client SHOULD skip sending this StateId during session recovery

tokens.name: SSPI
tokens.description: SSPI token returned during SPNEGO authentication login process.

structure.desc: SPNEGO security token

tokens.name: TABNAME
tokens.description: Sends table name to client. Only sent in browser mode or from sp_cursoropen.

structure.desc: Length of token stream (excludes TokenType and Length)

tokens.name: TVP_ROW
tokens.description: Sends a complete Table Valued Parameter (TVP) row from client to server. Format defined by TVP_COLMETADATA. Unlike ROW, does NOT use TextPointer+Timestamp prefix for TEXT/NTEXT/IMAGE.

structure.desc: One per column; some columns may be omitted per TVP_COLMETADATA Flags
